name: Sticker Collage, Printmaking and Craft Materials category. Label normalized from source descriptions.
visualIdentity: White sticker borders and light contact shadows sit on paper, notebook pages, or a simple surface. Stickers are placed, peeled, rotated, and repeated in arrangements. Border width and cutout scale stay consistent, and stickers keep surface contact rather than floating.
suitableUses: Explicitly suited to playful arrangements of existing subjects. Listed uses include kids' content, community channels, casual brand mascots, study notes, travel journals, and onboarding tips. Compatibility notes also list product introductions and explanatory narratives.
limitations: Do not pair with sticker-explainer styles, which would duplicate it. Avoid floating stickers without contact shadows, arrows crossing stickers, and too many simultaneous notes. Do not roughen every cutout edge. Omit chapter transitions for very short topics or when they obscure causality or break a required continuous shot.
palette: Suggested, not supplied: background #F3EBD9, foreground #273F49, accent_1 #FFFFFF as the sticker border, accent_2 #D78267 coral, accent_3 #77A397 sage. No gradient is enabled. Foreground on background measures 9.346 contrast. Coral and sage fall below 4.5 as text backgrounds, so they stay decorative. Task-provided colors override these values, and assets must not be recolored.
motionAndInteraction: Stickers move through layer transforms for placing, peeling, lifting, and slight rotation while keeping surface contact. Mo.js bursts are optional, restrained entrance accents only. Motion-012 and motion-015 are optional candidates that must pass scene-compatibility screening. Video motion must derive deterministically from composition time, and interactive hover or focus lift is possible.
audio: The style specifies no audio. Suitable choices depend on the topic and may include a restrained sound accent, ambience, or silence. No genre, tempo, voice, or mandatory audio layer is assigned. Any audio must not compete with narration or essential on-screen text.
assetRequirements: Alpha-masked cutouts must be expanded to produce uniform white borders and light shadows. Pillow or Sharp can preprocess assets. Rough.js is optional, only for sketch-like sticker interiors. Fonts and assets must load before rendering. Source asset resolution and sticker counts are unspecified.
combinations: Use alone for playful arrangements of existing subjects. Style-025 adds doodle characters using foreground linework and coral or sage fills only, with constant border width. Style-024 adds handwritten arrows and short notes on the paper, never on sticker borders, using foreground ink with coral emphasis.
productionApproach: HyperFrames is the default for composition, timing, audio sync, validation, and export. Remotion is a fallback only when HyperFrames is unavailable or a verified limitation exists, and the reason must be recorded. SVG is the primary style renderer, with Pixi.js, Rough.js, and mo.js optional. Verify decoded frames, audio sync, and loop seams before delivery.
